ground_truth.label: non_verbal_abuse
visible_evidence: Morgan silently faces Riley for a long interval.
Morgan does not move when Riley needs access to the chest.
Morgan repeatedly shifts into Riley's path.
Morgan blocks a narrow work path without doing useful work there.

description: Five Minecraft players decorate a garden. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained staring, refusal to move, and silent obstruction to test ambiguous non-verbal hostility.

stimulus.target_action: Riley plants red flowers in Riley's flower bed, walks toward the shared chest for more flowers, and pauses at the central narrow path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stands in the central narrow path facing Riley. Riley pauses in front of Morgan and turns toward the shared chest. Morgan remains still and continues facing Riley. Riley steps to the right side of the path; Morgan steps to the same side and stops there. Riley steps left; Morgan shifts left and again stands still without placing or breaking blocks.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the narrow path beside Riley, places a temporary solid block flush against Morgan’s shoulder to mark a boundary, steps through the reopened gap to stand between Morgan and Riley centered in the path, holds position until a clear lane to the chest is visible, then removes the temporary block and maintains stance keeping the lane open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the observer line to the edge of the narrow path, places a marker block one block off the path to the side, then steps back two blocks to stand where both Riley and Morgan can see the clear gap.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the path edge, quickly places a two-wide line of slabs forming a short detour around Morgan and Riley, gently shoulder-bumps Riley toward the new path, then shoulder-bumps Morgan onto it and stands centered on the original path to hold it clear.

target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward off the narrow path toward the garden edge, turns slightly toward the open space by the observer line, and walks in a gentle arc around the path congestion toward a wider approach to the shared chest, keeping a few blocks of distance from Morgan.
